description: Provider A is degraded; TensorFeed's signed ruling on the single best operational provider to fail over to for a task right now. Confirms A against the live incident-triage feed, then runs the route-verdict fusion with A (and any provider already in failover) excluded. Requires from. tier='preview' is free (10 calls per day per IP), the failover target only. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02) and adds the full candidate (pricing, measured p95 latency, quality), the ranked alternatives, the confirmed incident on A, and an AFTA-signed receipt. Omit tier and you get the free preview, unless the call carries a payment or credits token (or uses the strict x402 transport), in which case it bills as full. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

from.description: The degraded provider to fail over FROM (e.g. "anthropic", "openai"). Required.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

task.description: Task type to optimize the failover target for. Optional.

tier.description: 'preview' (free, 10 calls per IP per day) or 'full' (1 credit; adds candidate detail, ranked alternatives, incident, signed receipt). Omitted: preview, unless a payment or credits token is attached.

name: failover_verdict
